hooks.name: Emergency Override Check
hooks.description: Ensures emergency alert components always take visual priority (enforces safety guardrail at code level).

action.prompt:
An alert component or page layout was just saved. Verify emergency alerts always take visual priority:

1. Verify AlertBanner renders at the TOP of the page layout (z-50 or higher).
2. Verify AlertBanner cannot be permanently dismissed — only temporarily hidden.
3. Verify the emergency state overrides normal chat flow.
4. Verify a "Tawagan ang 911" button is always visible with a minimum 44x44px touch target.
5. Verify alert colors use #E53E3E — never muted or subtle.

Report which checks passed and which failed. For each failure, name the file and line and describe the fix needed.
